scripts.prepare:build: cp -r locales core/frontend/lib/ && cp -r theme core/frontend/lib/ && cp -r config core/frontend/lib/ && cp -r assets/frontend/public/* core/frontend/public/ && cp -r assets/backend/watermark core/backend/assets/
scripts.build: npm run prepare:build && cd core/frontend && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:build && cd core && npm run dev
scripts.seed: COUNTRY=mk npm run prepare:build && cd core/backend && COUNTRY=mk npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/stage/seed.ts
scripts.reset-and-seed: COUNTRY=mk npm run prepare:build && cd core/backend && COUNTRY=mk npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/stage/reset-and-seed.ts
scripts.add-brands: cd core/backend && npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/stage/add-brands.ts
scripts.seed-all-brands: cd core/backend && npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/stage/seed-all-brands.ts
scripts.check-models-validity: cd core/backend && COUNTRY=mk npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/stage/check-models-validity.ts
